evidence.quoted_text: exec(compile(data, str(path), "exec"), module.__dict__)  # noqa: S102 - bound bytes
evidence.reason: The helper loader compiles the readable bytes without catching SyntaxError. Unlike _load_live_binding, which translates SyntaxError into Refused, _load_helper only refuses unreadable or hash-mismatched helpers; a syntactically invalid helper escapes this boundary before the controller's normal error handling. In --json mode that yields no stdout JSON error object and a stderr traceback, contrary to I1 item 2. The smallest compatible fix is to catch the compile SyntaxError at this boundary and raise Refused while preserving the existing hash check and bound-bytes execution.
